verdict.rationale: Ironclad's no-code contract builder, workflow designer, and e-signature capabilities (docs-9, docs-10, docs-16, docs-13) generically support drafting documents and routing them for approval/signature, which could technically be applied to board consents or resolutions, but there is no evidence of board-consent/resolution templates, cap-table integration, or any equity-fundraising-specific workflow — Ironclad is a general CLM tool, not a startup-equity specialized product.  missing for 10: named board consent/resolution templates, equity-fundraising-specific workflows, evidence of actual use for board approvals.
